description: Deterministic release-gate contract for the PetTripFinder Nashville market through PTF-NASHVILLE-TN-PROMOTION-AND-NEW-LANE-LAUNCH-PREP-002. Every number is derived from THIS market's committed authority; none is inherited from or comparable to another market's contract.

deployment_authorization.means: A passing contract means this market's assembled package is STRUCTURALLY deployable: its authority files agree, its routes match its reviewed inventory, no held identity leaks, and every publish gate holds. It is not a deployment authorization and asserts nothing about the market being complete -- 167 of this market's 180 registered identities are still unresolved, 88 rows are held by the modern production gates and publish nothing, and no founder deployment decision exists for Nashville at 8 published profiles.

identity_census.note: 180 registered identities, carried across from the 181-identity shadow PTF-NASHVILLE-TN-NEW-MARKET-001 built from zero for $0 and 17 Firecrawl credits. Membership is this market's own corridor postal partition (census_membership_basis CORRIDOR_REGISTRY), with Opryland and Vanderbilt/West End claiming their properties by explicit_hotel_ids so display stays true without making membership ambiguous. One shadow identity is NOT registered: the registered census contract requires a city and no committed source states one for it. It is named in nashville_tn_identity_holds_002.json.

reconciliation.note: PTF-NASHVILLE-TN-PROMOTION-AND-NEW-LANE-LAUNCH-PREP-002 registered the clean inventory PTF-NASHVILLE-TN-NEW-MARKET-001 left pending -- 80 clean pet-friendly and 19 clean verified-no-pets. The count gate reproduced all four shadow numbers exactly BEFORE any row was removed, and only then did the modern gates run. 88 rows are held and publish nothing (1 CONTRACT_MIGRATION_ERROR; 2 CROSS_MARKET_COLLISION; 85 MODERN_EVIDENCE_GATE_HOLD; by gate: 1 CITY_NOT_STATED_BY_ANY_COMMITTED_SOURCE; 2 GLOBAL_PUBLISHED_IDENTITY_KEY_ALREADY_OWNED; 84 NO_CAPTURE_HASH; 1 NO_TIMESTAMP). The dominant hold is NO_CAPTURE_HASH: the shadow's attended browser lane read 154 pages for $0 and recorded a byte LENGTH rather than a document hash, so those reads cannot be tied to a document and cannot be published. Every held row keeps its registered census identity. No gate was lowered to preserve a count.

reconciliation_cross_checks.note: The committed final partition is the disposition authority; every registered census identity appears in it exactly once.

policy_package.note: The verified hotel identities are DERIVED from this package at assembly time via site_data.verified_public_hotels(); they are not restated here. Every record carries the exact operator quote for each published fact, the capture lane, the sha256 of the document it was read from, and -- because every published row here came through a paid lane -- the reservation that bought the page, whose request envelope hash is derived from the committed run rather than invented.

public_surface.held_hotel_exclusion: Every seed hotel this market owns that is absent from the committed package (not-published seed hotels: held/manual-review plus rows still pending evidence) must have NO public route and NO reference on any surface: hotel profiles, the hotels listing/category page, nearby-lodging cards on any page, the policy-comparison table, the sitemap, canonicals, internal links, and /go/ interstitials. This market currently holds none -- every seed row it owns is published -- and the gate is derived, so it starts enforcing the moment that changes.

routes.note: route_mode market_prefixed: this market's hub, corridor and policy-comparison pages live under /pet-friendly-hotels/nashville-tn/. 0 of 19 corridors reach their own publication minimum; the rest are suppressed, which is a threshold and not a gap. The market and its corridors are hidden from navigation and the sitemap (show_in_navigation=false, show_in_sitemap=false) until a launch order says otherwise.

publish.note: The publish root must contain ONLY the static website plus the two Netlify control files. Build-internal reports the generator emits (_build_report.json, _broken_link_report.json, _quality_report.json, bundle_manifest.json) are read for gating but are excluded from site/ and must never ship.
